entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 source 2439222638771000448: position at J2016.0. Distance: Gaia DR3 parallax 8.9150 +/- 0.0583 mas (same row, RUWE 1.10): 112.17 pc, no zero-point correction. Proper motion: Gaia DR3 (same row): -2.039, -42.334 mas/yr. Radial velocity from No catalogued radial velocity: Gaia DR3 measures none for source 2439222638771000448 and SIMBAD lists none. Zero is assumed; a 30 km/s error moves the star by one part in 40,000 of its distance per century.

entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 0.298 +/- 0.009 solar radii from Castro González et al. 2020, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of K2-325 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2020MNRAS.499.5416C/abstract). Mass 0.274 +/- 0.008 solar masses from Castro González et al. 2020, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of K2-325 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2020MNRAS.499.5416C/abstract). Temperature 3287 +/- 67 K from Castro González et al. 2020, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of K2-325 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive.

entries.subject: Colour
entries.finding: A Planck spectrum at 3,287 K, because no archive holds a spectrum of this star (stis-ngsl: no HD number in SIMBAD; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: no HR number; kiehling: no HR number; kharitonov: no HR number; burnashev: no HR (BS) number), through the CIE 1931 2-degree observer: #ffc17f. Routes tried in order: stis-ngsl: no HD number in SIMBAD; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: no HR number; kiehling: no HR number; kharitonov: no HR number; burnashev: no HR (BS) number; planck: used.

entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret (2017), A&A 600, A30 computes from PHOENIX model atmospheres for the TESS band at 3,287 K and log g 4.93 (u1 0.155, u2 0.461): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used.
